newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat in very thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat in very thin trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed little changed at 494.30/495.00 per dollar on Thursday with trading down to a snail's pace after a recent ruling by the central bank, traders said.
The bolivar closed at 494.00/494.75 per dollar Wednesday.
Traders said a central bank resolution introduced last week to clamp down on interbank currency trading had effectively dried up demand in the market.
"This ruling has killed the market," one trader said.
"Not even the high liquidity on money markets has forced a resumption of currency demand," a second trader said.
Traders expected the exchange rate to be broadly unchanged in thin trade in coming sessions.
